svg.title: LCW, all of it
svg.desc: The full architecture of LCW. Around your session: the mod reads the run every 2 seconds and draws its card above your prompt and the pink box to approve, answer or resume; the status line shows the mascot, the model, the context and the week's usage against your usage mark; the hooks give Claude the lcw command line and the run at start, and at the mark tell it to stop and refuse new agents. The main session, on your model, holds the intent and records everything with lcw in a run folder outside the repository: state.json, ledger.md and artifacts. Build: Brainstorm with Haiku and Sonnet probes, brainstorm.md, your one approval; Spec with an Opus blind-reviewer, an Opus feasibility-reviewer and a Haiku probe, spec.md and map.md. Sweep: Charter with Haiku and Sonnet probes and a Sonnet reviewer for the baseline, charter.md, your one approval; Hunt with Haiku, Sonnet or Opus probes, findings.md and parked.md. Both then: Plan, plan.md; Build with workers, a Sonnet or Opus milestone-reviewer that sees only the code, and for very large runs Opus orchestrators; Review with Opus or Sonnet reviewers against the spec, one running the suites and one comparing approved mocks; Ship, the draft pull request. A sweep goes back to Hunt.
svg.text: Every agent with its model, the records each stage keeps, and what sits around your session.
You, at your prompt in Claude Code
Reads the run every 2 seconds. Draws its card
above your prompt, and the pink box: approve,
answer a question, resume an unfinished run.
Two rows under your prompt: the mascot,
the model, the context, and the week's
Your model and effort (Fable, high, recommended).
Holds the intent, briefs and launches the agents,
decides, and records everything with lcw. Never
writes or reviews code. With an advisor turned on
(claude --advisor fable), it asks it at every stage.
line, and the run to carry on.
At the mark: stop, on each
prompt and tool call; no new
The run folder, outside the repository
Only lcw writes the state and the ledger; the
stages below write their own records here.
THE STAGES: WHO WORKS, AND WHAT EACH KEEPS
Each agent with the model LCW suggests for that job; the main session picks each one at launch.
You and Claude settle what you really mean,
finds and lists: the code, earlier runs
judges, or runs a small real test
Goals, limits, no-go zones, when it stops,
and how its pull requests land.
counts the work, area by area
sizes each area: what kinds of change
the baseline: your checks, before any fix
Your intent written down: what, never how.
gets the spec's text alone; explains it back
can each requirement be built here?
maps the code for the plan
Each problem comes with a recipe, and is
sorted: fix, park for you, or drop. The fixes
queue up as waves, each in its own worktree.
one per part, by what a miss costs
The main session splits the work into tasks, each with its own files and
tests, groups them into milestones, and picks each one's model.
Workers build a milestone's tasks side by side, in the run's worktree;
each milestone is checked while the next one builds.
blind: the code only, no spec
very large runs: one milestone each
Checked against the spec, requirement by requirement; the full suites
run in its first round and once more at its end.
The main session writes the draft pull request: what, why and how,
with pictures. In a sweep, as the charter says: one per wave or one at the end.
